verdicts.reason: A reads left to right as a banner should: brand and headline on the left, date in the middle, and a prominent RSVP button grouped with its URL on the right. Its flaws: the can graphic floats awkwardly at the top centre, the headline is undersized for the format, the legal line sits right under the subtitle, and the missing-asset placeholder is still visible. B shrinks the RSVP button to a pill the same size as the FREE ENTRY/ALL AGES/TASTINGS badges, which buries the CTA. The two-line 'Sunset / Sessions' headline crowds against those pills, the subtitle is squeezed into a narrow, ragged column, the logo wordmark looks broken ('SOLST CE'), the legal text is tiny and stuffed into the right side, and the placeholder overlaps that corner.
